title: Find the deployed revision
brief: Find the shop application for the named environment. Use the Applications list, open it, and find the deployed revision and its health.

checks.question: Which Application matches the briefing?
checks.hint: Use the environment label on the Applications list.
checks.why: The list shows the environment and health before you open an app.

checks.question: What health status does the application header show?
checks.hint: Look beside the sync status in the application header.
checks.why: The header is the fastest way to confirm current health.

checks.question: Which Git revision is deployed?
checks.hint: Open History and Rollback and read the latest revision.
checks.why: History ties the deployed revision to a sync event.
